title: Prompt Patterns That Work
description: Learn the most effective repeatable prompt patterns — from role-play to step-by-step to "think aloud".

data.text: Beyond the basic CRTF framework, certain prompt patterns reliably produce better results across very different tasks. Think of these as repeatable recipes you can combine and remix. Unlike one-off prompts, patterns are transferable — once you know them, you use them everywhere.

rows: When precision matters, when length control is needed

data.text: Telling the AI to act as a specific expert sets its tone, vocabulary, and approach. It activates the most relevant patterns from its training. The more specific the role, the better the output.

data.title: Role-play — basic
data.content: "Act as a senior product manager reviewing a feature spec. Be direct and focus on user impact and technical feasibility."

data.title: Role-play — advanced with audience
data.content: "You are a friendly GP explaining a medical test result to a worried patient who has no medical background. Use plain language, avoid jargon, and be reassuring but honest. Here is the result: [PASTE]"

data.text: You can also specify who NOT to be: "Don't be overly technical. Don't be condescending. Don't use jargon." Negative role constraints are just as powerful.

Asking the AI to reason step by step dramatically improves accuracy on complex problems. This explicit reasoning technique — called chain-of-thought prompting — is well-studied in AI research and consistently improves results on problems requiring planning or calculation.

data.title: Step-by-step — budget decision
data.content: "Think through this step by step before answering: I have a $10,000 marketing budget to reach professionals aged 35-50 in London. Walk through which channels would be most cost-effective, what the trade-offs are, and give me a recommended split."

data.title: Step-by-step — problem diagnosis
data.content: "My website conversion rate dropped 30% last week. Think step by step through the possible causes — technical, content, traffic source, and pricing factors. Then rank the most likely causes."

data.text: Giving the AI something to transform is one of the most reliable patterns. You supply the input, specify what needs to change, and optionally show what the result should look like.

data.title: Before/after — rewrite
data.content: "Here is a paragraph I wrote [PASTE]. Rewrite it to be 30% shorter while keeping all the key information. Show me the original and the rewritten version side by side with word counts."

data.title: Before/after — tone shift
data.content: "Here is my reply to a negative customer review: [PASTE]. Rewrite it to be: (1) empathetic, not defensive; (2) under 50 words; (3) end with an invitation to resolve the issue. Show before and after."

data.text: Constraints force the AI to be precise. Word limits, format rules, banned words, and specific requirements all dramatically improve output quality. Constraints are especially powerful when you know exactly what you do NOT want.

data.title: Constraint prompt — with bans
data.content: "Summarize this in exactly 3 bullets. Each bullet must start with an action verb. Maximum 15 words per bullet. Do NOT use the word "important". Do NOT include statistics."

data.title: Constraint prompt — audience level
data.content: "Explain blockchain to me in under 150 words. Assume I know nothing about technology. No technical terms. No metaphors involving chains or blocks."

data.text: Give the AI the skeleton, have it fill in the flesh. Output templates are the fastest way to get consistently structured documents — meeting notes, reports, job postings, proposals, emails.

data.title: Meeting notes template
data.content:
"Fill in this template based on the notes below:
## Meeting Summary
**Date:** [DATE]
**Attendees:** [NAMES]
**Key decisions made:** [LIST]
**Action items:** [OWNER: TASK by DATE]
**Open questions:** [LIST]
**Next meeting:** [DATE]

Meeting notes: [PASTE]"

data.text: The real power comes from combining patterns. A single prompt can use role-play + step-by-step + output template all at once. Here is an example:

data.title: Combined pattern prompt — business analysis
data.content:
"Role: You are a senior business consultant. Tone: direct, no fluff.

Context: I'm evaluating whether to launch a SaaS product in Southeast Asia vs. Latin America.

Task: Think through this step by step — consider market size, competition, regulatory environment, and go-to-market difficulty.

Format:
## Region 1: Southeast Asia
- Market opportunity: [2-3 sentences]
- Key risks: [bullet list]
- Verdict: [1 sentence]

## Region 2: Latin America
[same structure]

## My recommendation
[2-3 sentences with clear rationale]"

→ This one prompt will return a structured, consultant-quality analysis.

data.title: The 5 core patterns
points: Role-play — set an expert persona; specify tone and what to avoid
Step-by-step — force reasoning on hard problems; dramatically improves accuracy
Before/After — show what to transform; most reliable for editing tasks
Constraints — force precision with word limits, format rules, and banned terms
Output template — give the AI the skeleton; it fills in the detail
Combine patterns for complex tasks — role + step-by-step + template = best results

data.text: Choosing the right pattern for the job

Prompt patterns are tools, not goals. The best pattern depends on risk level, required precision, and audience. For low-risk ideation, lightweight patterns work. For high-impact outputs, use structured patterns with explicit checks.
